response.reason: CVE-2019-3562 allows an attacker to 'potentially execute code' via HTML injection into the Oculus Browser UI. CVE-2020-1885 requires an existing 'local users' context 'on Windows' to exploit a hard link vector in OVRRedir.exe. The causal bridge assumes same-host co-location and that the modal 'potentially execute code' yields an unprivileged Windows local user context with filesystem access; because these cannot be inferred from the CVE descriptions alone, the transition is conditional and cannot enter a strict graph without external verification.
